analyses: base, high-load, outage and target-year sensitivities
replacement_target: Operator-supplied CGMES/planning topology, impedances, ratings, loading snapshots, security criteria, protection and connection queue
regulatory_context: FCA restrictions for German storage and consuming facilities may be static or dynamic and remain subject to operator assessment and agreement.
limitations: All electrical branch parameters and base loading are deterministic synthetic demonstration assumptions.
The result does not establish free, available, reserved, connectable or operator-confirmed capacity.
N-1 is a conservative proxy and not an operator security assessment.
